init_distributed_mode_torchrun: initialize distributed training mode for single and multi-GPU jobs using torchrun with NCCL backend
run_torchrun_distributed: run a PyTorch distributed training job across multiple GPUs on a single node using torchrun
setup_nccl_backend: set up the NCCL backend for multi-GPU communication and initialize the process group with environment variables
configure_gloo_group: configure a GLOO distributed group with a 600-second timeout for cross-process communication
set_gpu_device: set the CUDA device for the current process based on its local rank in the distributed setup
